At 11 a.m. 19/9/40 F.S. Weed No.349 and C.P.
C. 420 escorted to Gordon Road Police Station the
complainant namely YUE KWANG ZER (阮坤全), age
35 years, native of Ningpo, manager of the Dar Foh
(大福) Dry Goods Shop No.640 Connaught Road and
the five culprits namely:-
1st accused:-LUE LUNG YAH (刘英侠), age
22 years, native of Ningpo,
2nd accused:-TSANG CHING TENG (張錦堂), age
28 years, native of Chinkiang,
3rd accused:-YANG TS TUH (楊世德), age 33
years, native of Kiangsu,
4th accused:-WONG SUNG (洪森), age 38 years,
native of Ningpo and the
5th accused:-MEI LI CHING (梅蘭卿), age
34 years, native of Ningpo, the complainant accusing
the five culprits of having endeavoured to abduct
him.
Subsequent enquiries by C.D.C. 169, C.D.C.138
and the undersigned ascertained the following:-
The 1st and 2nd accused were formerly employed
in the Dar Foh Dry Goods Shop No.640 Connaught Road
as shop-assistants and on the Mid-Autumn Festival
(16/9/40) they approached the complainant (their
manager) requesting an increase in pay the request
however being refused whereupon the culprits resigned.
At about 10.30 a.m. 19/9/40 the five accused
hired a Johnson Hire Car No. 1854 from a garage
situated on Kiaochow Road and Yu Yuen Road corner
and when the vehicle arrived at the given location
the culprits then entered the Dar Foh Dry Goods

1940年9月19日上午11时，外勤警员 Reed 编号349 和 华捕 C. 420
将原告即 YUE KWANG ZER (阮坤全)，35岁，宁波人，康纳路640号大福 (Dar Foh) 百货店经理，
以及五名罪犯即：-
第一被告：- LUE LUNG YAH (刘英侠)，22岁，宁波人，
第二被告：- TSANG CHING TENG (張錦堂)，28岁，镇江人，
第三被告：- YANG TS TUH (楊世德)，33岁，江苏人，
第四被告：- WONG SUNG (洪森)，38岁，宁波人，以及
第五被告：- MEI LI CHING (梅蘭卿)，34岁，宁波人，护送至戈登路警察局，
原告指控这五名罪犯企图绑架他。
经华探长 169、华探长 138 及签署人随后的调查，查明以下情况：-
第一和第二被告此前受雇于康纳路640号大福百货店担任店员，
在中秋节（1940年9月16日），他们向原告（他们的经理）提出加薪要求，
但该要求被拒绝，随后罪犯辞职。
1940年9月19日上午10时30分左右，五名被告从胶州路与愚园路拐角处的一个车库
租用了一辆约翰逊租车行 (Johnson Hire Car) 的1854号汽车，
当车辆到达指定地点时，罪犯随即进入大福百货

Loh Ling Kung (陸林根)。
Shanghai.                                      C.D.C. 138.
Gend. Stn.            19/9/40.          translated clerk, Chen Yuan Fan.

My name is Loh Ling Kung, age 33, native of Shanghai.
I am married, employed as a driver in the Johnson Hire Car
Co., and holding a driving permit No.9157.
At 20.41 a.m. 19/9/40 whilst I was on duty at No.7
Sub-Station at 110 Yu Yuen Road, I was instructed by the
accountant to drive M/Car No. 16534 to 640 Connaught Road.
I then took one chit and drove the car to 640 Connaught Road.
On arrival I noticed the premises in question is a dry-goods
shop, and a male Chinese wearing grey long gown (Tsang Ching
Daung) was standing outside the shop, who then told me to wait
for a few minutes. He then together with another male
Chinese wearing blue long gown (Liau Ying Yah) caught hold of
a male Chinese and dragged him from the dry goods shop into
my car. This male Chinese shouted "Kidnappers", whilst they
(exhibit) told me to drive the car to Lane 95 House 10 Edinburgh Road,
south of Yu Yuen Road and North of Great Western Road, where-
upon I learned that they were not good elements and as the
result of my observation I immediately refused to drive the
car. At that time C.P.C. 420 came to the scene, and I then
20.
reported the above occurrence to the police officer, who in
turn brought all concerned to this station. The paper bearing
address was given to me by Tsang Ching Daung.
The above is my true statement.

Signed: -Loh Ling Kung.
pages.zh:
Loh Ling Kung (陸林根)。
上海。                                      华探长 138.
巡捕房            1940年9月19日。          翻译书记员，Chen Yuan Fan。

我叫 Loh Ling Kung，33岁，上海人。
我已婚，受雇于约翰逊租车行 (Johnson Hire Car Co.) 担任司机，
持有驾驶证编号9157。
1940年9月19日晚上8时41分，当我在愚园路110号第7分站值班时，
会计指示我驾驶机动车编号 16534 前往康纳路640号。
我随后取了一张派车单，驾车前往康纳路640号。
到达后，我注意到该处是一家百货店，一名身穿灰色长衫的中国男子 (Tsang Ching Daung)
站在店外，他让我等几分钟。随后，他与另一名身穿蓝色长衫的中国男子 (Liau Ying Yah)
一起抓住一名中国男子，将他从百货店拖进我的车里。这名中国男子高喊“绑匪”，
而他们（物证）命令我将车开往愚园路以南、大西路以北的爱丁堡路95弄10号，
于是我意识到他们不是良民，基于我的观察，我立即拒绝开车。
当时华捕班长 420 赶到现场，我随即向该警官报告了上述情况，
他随即将所有相关人员带到本站。那张写有地址的纸条是 Tsang Ching Daung 给我的。
以上是我的真实供词。

签名：-Loh Ling Kung。

Yuen Kweng Zien (阮 坤 全 ).
--- C.D.C. 138.
translated
------- Clerk, Tung Yih Hsiang.

Ningpo.
Gend. Stn. 19/9/40.

My name is Yuen Kweng Zien, age 35 years, and a native
of Ningpo. I am married and have operated the "Dah Poh"
Provision Shop situated at House No.640 Connaught Road for
more than two years.

During the month of December 1939, I employed a casual
shop-assistant named Lieu Iung Yah. On the approach of the
Chinese Eve, we were very busy with our business therefore I
promised to pay the newly-appointed assistant $15.00 per
month as wages. After the Chinese New Year, Lieu Iung Yah
applied to me for being considered as a permanent employee
which I approved and gave him a monthly wages of $10.00
for same. In view of his daily diligence and devotion to
the discharge of his duties, I added $2.00 a month to his
salary from January to the Dragon Boat Festival. Following
the Dragon Boat Festival, another additional sum of $2.00 was
given to him thus making a total salary of $14.00 per month.
Afterwards however he was lazy and I asked him why to which
he replied stating that he was not well remunerated and
further proposed that he be allowed a further increase of pay.
In response to his request, I told him that owing to the
depression of our trade, I could not accept the above demand,
then he and the other employee named Tsang Ching Dong both
resigned of their own accord.

At about 9 a.m. 19/9/40, Lieu Iung Yah, Tsang Ching Dong
and three others unknown to me came to my shop. One of the
three unknown persons, later ascertained to be named Yang Su
Tuh, claimed to be a member of the Labour Union and they
pages.zh:
Yuen Kweng Zien (阮 坤 全 )。
--- 华探长 138.
翻译
------- 书记员，Tung Yih Hsiang。

宁波。
巡捕房 1940年9月19日。

我叫 Yuen Kweng Zien，35岁，宁波人。我已婚，经营位于康纳路640号的“大福” (Dah Poh) 杂货店已有两年多。

1939年12月期间，我雇用了一名临时店员，名叫 Lieu Iung Yah。临近除夕时，我们生意繁忙，
因此我承诺每月支付这名新聘助手15.00元作为工资。春节过后，Lieu Iung Yah 申请转为正式员工，
我批准了他的申请，并给予他每月10.00元的工资。鉴于他日常勤勉尽职，
从一月到端午节期间，我每月给他加薪2.00元。端午节后，又额外给他增加了2.00元，
使其月薪总额达到14.00元。然而后来他变得懒惰，我询问原因，
他回答说报酬不高，并进一步提议再次加薪。
针对他的要求，我告诉他由于行业不景气，我不能接受上述要求，
随后他和另一名雇员 Tsang Ching Dong 自行辞职。

1940年9月19日上午9点左右，Lieu Iung Yah、Tsang Ching Dong 以及另外三名我不认识的人来到我的店里。
这三名陌生人中的一人，后查明名为 Yang Su Tuh，声称自己是工会成员，他们

pages.en:
Yuen Kweng Zien (2)

( 5 in number) then pulled me out of my shop by force to a
waiting M/car which was stationary at the entrance of the
shop premises. On the alarm of 'Kidnappers' being raised
by me, the culprits ordered the chauffeur to drive the car
hurriedly, the chauffeur however being fully aware of the
situation refused to drive as was ordered with the result
that I was arrested by police officers.
The above is my true statement.

signed:-Yuan Kweng Zien.
pages.zh:
Yuen Kweng Zien (2)

（共五人）随后强行将我拉出店铺，带到停在店门口的一辆等候的汽车上。
当我发出“绑匪”的警报时，罪犯命令司机赶快开车，
但司机完全清楚情况，拒绝按命令开车，结果我被警察逮捕。
以上是我的真实供词。

签名：-Yuan Kweng Zien。
